mapper.select:
SELECT
id title uploader uploaded_at AS "uploadedAt" file_size_bytes AS "fileSizeBytes" status tags city platform reviewer remark resolution duration_sec AS "durationSec" source_dataset AS "sourceDataset" source_id AS "sourceId" ingested_at AS "ingestedAt"
id, title, uploader, uploaded_at AS "uploadedAt", file_size_bytes AS "fileSizeBytes", status, tags, city, platform, reviewer, remark, resolution, duration_sec AS "durationSec", source_dataset AS "sourceDataset", source_id AS "sourceId", ingested_at AS "ingestedAt"
FROM assets
ORDER BY
uploaded_at file_size_bytes title uploader status city ingested_at id uploaded_at
DESC ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assets (source_dataset, source_id, title, uploader, uploaded_at, file_size_bytes, status, tags, city, platform, reviewer, remark, resolution, duration_sec, extra, raw_record) VALUES (#{sourceDataset}, #{sourceId}, #{title}, #{uploader}, #{uploadedAt}, #{fileSizeBytes}, #{status}, #{tags, typeHandler=com.homework.asset.config.PgStringArrayTypeHandler}, #{city}, #{platform}, #{reviewer}, #{remark}, #{resolution}, #{durationSec}, #{extra, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{rawRecord, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (source_dataset, source_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, uploader = EXCLUDED.uploader, uploaded_at = EXCLUDED.uploaded_at, file_size_bytes = EXCLUDED.file_size_bytes, status = EXCLUDED.status, tags = EXCLUDED.tags, city = EXCLUDED.city, platform = EXCLUDED.platform, reviewer = EXCLUDED.reviewer, remark = EXCLUDED.remark, resolution = EXCLUDED.resolution, duration_sec = EXCLUDED.duration_sec, extra = EXCLUDED.extra, raw_record = EXCLUDED.raw_record, ingested_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT uploader, COUNT(*) AS "approvedCount", ROUND(AVG(file_size_bytes)) AS "avgSizeBytes", pg_size_pretty(ROUND(AVG(file_size_bytes))::bigint) AS "avgSizeHuman" FROM assets WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY uploader ORDER BY "avgSizeBytes" DESC
SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM assets, UNNEST(tags) AS tag GROUP BY tag ORDER BY "count" DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH base AS ( SELECT platform, status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM assets WHERE platform IS NOT NULL GROUP BY platform, status ) SELECT platform, SUM(cnt) AS "total", COALESCE(SUM(cnt) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'), 0) AS "approved", ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(cnt) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved'), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt), 0), 2) AS "approvalRate" FROM base GROUP BY platform ORDER BY "approvalRate" DESC NULLS LAST
